ai_language_tip: Speak warm, natural Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR); English is rarely spoken outside international hotels in São Paulo or Rio Zona Sul.
english_ok: rarely — Only upscale international hotels and select São Paulo/Rio corporate venues handle English phone calls.
politeness: Warm and friendly; open with 'Oi, bom dia / boa tarde, tudo bem?' before stating request, use 'por favor' and 'você' or polite 'o senhor/a senhora'; close with 'obrigado(a)'.
name_tip: First name (or first + surname, e.g. João Silva, Ana Oliveira) is primary everywhere—Brazilians address everyone by first name!
phone_tip: 2-digit DDD area code + 9-digit mobile (11) 91234-5678, landline (11) 3123-4567; digit 6 spoken as 'meia'; WhatsApp is universal!
time_tip: 12-hour spoken ('sete e meia da noite', 'meio-dia e meia'), 'quinze pras oito' = 7:45; confirm 'da manhã/da tarde/da noite'.
number_tip: Digit 6 is almost always spoken as 'meia' (half-dozen) to avoid confusing 'seis' with 'três' or 'sete'!
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch peak 12:00–13:30 for small clinics/offices, restaurant rush 12:00–14:00 and 20:00–21:30, and calls after 20:30.
closed_days: Many salons and bistros close Mondays; workshops close Sundays and Saturday afternoons; Carnaval and Christmas–New Year bring multi-day slowdowns.
booking_channels: WhatsApp dominates every single sector in Brazil; Tagme, Get In, and TheFork for restaurants; Doctoralia for doctors; Trinks/avec for salons; iFood for delivery.
voice_menu: Health plans (Unimed/Bradesco/Amil), diagnostic labs (Fleury/Dasa), banks, Vivo/Claro/TIM, airlines (Azul/GOL/LATAM), and utilities use heavy keypad URA.
callback_habits: Businesses immediately message the caller's number on WhatsApp ('Posso confirmar pelo Whats?') and reconfirm 24h before.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 巴西許多熱門餐廳不接晚間尖峰訂位（僅留早場至 19:30 或用 Get In 線上排隊），且店員常會導向 WhatsApp 確認。
usually_asked: Date and arrival hour (many hold tables only until 19:30/20:00 on weekends!)
Number of people (lugares/pessoas) and cadeirão infantil
Indoor AC area (salão interno) vs varanda/área externa
First and last name plus WhatsApp number with DDD

may_come_up.what: Table tolerance is 15 minutes max; after 19:30 walk-in/Get In queue only
Optional 10–13% service fee and optional couvert artístico (live music charge)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF number for reservation list
Demands immediate Pix deposit (sinal no Pix)

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 診所與牙醫電話及 WhatsApp 普及，必問醫保（Convênio）或自費（Particular），且常索取 CPF。
usually_asked: Particular (self-pay) vs Convênio (Unimed, Bradesco Saúde, SulAmérica, Amil — plus plan tier!)
First consultation (primeira vez) or return visit within 30 days (retorno)

may_come_up.what: Large lab/hospital central line uses URA keypad menu
Doctor only accepts specific high tiers of the convênio or offers reimbursement receipt (reembolso)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF, birth date, or carteirinha do convênio number
Demands advance Pix transfer to confirm particular consultation

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美髮沙龍（Salão）週五週六極滿，獨立美甲（Manicure）與美睫常要求先轉 Pix 訂金（sinal）。
usually_asked: Service (corte, escova, mechas, pé e mão / gel, massagem)

may_come_up.what: Salon uses Trinks app or sends WhatsApp confirmation

sensitive_asked.what: Requires immediate Pix deposit (sinal via Pix) to hold slot

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車廠與授權維修站常接電話並轉 WhatsApp 報價；聖保羅市區送修需注意車牌限行（Rodízio）。
usually_asked: Vehicle model/year/plate or appliance/phone model and voltage (110V vs 220V!)

may_come_up.what: São Paulo municipal plate rodízio restricts driving 07:00–10:00 and 17:00–20:00
Orçamento sem compromisso (free quote) vs inspection fee

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF for service order or phone unlock password
Demands Pix advance for ordering parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外送多走 iFood；傳統披薩店、便當與烘焙坊仍接電話訂自取，或派外送員帶刷卡機收款。
usually_asked: Retirada no balcão (pickup) vs entrega própria
Items, half-and-half pizza flavors (meia a meia), and drink sizes
Pickup time or full address with CEP and apartment block
Payment method on delivery if rider brings card machine (maquininha — crédito ou débito!)

may_come_up.what: Rider brings wireless card terminal (leva a maquininha) on delivery
Store directs orders to iFood or WhatsApp catalog link

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF number over phone for receipt (CPF na nota)
Demands Pix transfer before preparing order

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型零售連鎖走總機語音，社區建材行（Material de construção）、汽車材料、藥局與花店可電話問現貨。
usually_asked: Product name, brand, voltage (110V/220V), or size

may_come_up.what: Cash/Pix discount (desconto à vista no Pix) vs installment card price (parcelado)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF number over phone
Requires immediate Pix transfer to hold item

change.before_dialing_zh: 診所與沙龍電話或 WhatsApp 改期（remarcar）很普遍。

may_come_up.what: Forfeits prior sinal if canceled inside 24h

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks CPF to look up patient schedule

usually_asked: Question (feriado hours, estacionamento/valet, taxa de rolha, pet friendly, stock)

may_come_up.what: Valet parking (manobrista) fee and corkage (taxa de rolha) quoted

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 海灘與山區民宿（Pousada）極習慣電話轉 WhatsApp 報價並收 50% Pix 訂金；商務飯店有語音選單且需信用卡。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates (pacote de feriado minimums common!)
Adults and children (ages for free child policy)
Suite/room category and café da manhã inclusion

may_come_up.what: Pousada sends quote via WhatsApp for owner to pay deposit directly

sensitive_asked.what: Requests CPF or credit card number over phone
Demands immediate 50% Pix transfer now

activity.before_dialing_zh: 沙灘網球（Beach Tennis 在巴西極紅！）、五人制足球（Society）、保齡球與烤肉區包場常接電話或用 Playtomic/App。
usually_asked: Court type (quadra de beach tennis, futebol society, pista de boliche)

may_come_up.what: Arena uses LetzPlay/Playtomic app or holds briefly pending Pix

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate Pix sinal to lock quadra

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須給完整地址（含 8 碼 CEP 與大樓名）；巴西大樓門禁（Portaria）極嚴，師傅姓名與車號必須事先由住戶向警衛授權放行！
usually_asked: Service (encanador, eletricista, limpeza de ar-condicionado, dedetização, chaveiro)
Street, number, bloco/apto, neighborhood (bairro), and 8-digit CEP
Condominium service-hours rule (horário de obra no condomínio, usually Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00!)

may_come_up.what: Provides technician full name/RG so resident can authorize entry at portaria
Quotes taxa de visita if service not executed

sensitive_asked.what: Asks resident CPF or electronic gate password
Demands Pix advance before visiting

pet.before_dialing_zh: 寵物店洗澡美容（Banho e tosa）與獸醫極普及，許多店家提供專車接送（Táxi Dog）。
usually_asked: Banho e tosa (higiênica/tesoura/máquina), vet consult, or hotelzinho/creche
V8/V10, antirrábica, and gripe vaccines up to date
Preferred time or Táxi Dog home pickup

may_come_up.what: Offers Táxi Dog pickup/drop-off service for extra fee

sensitive_asked.what: Asks tutor CPF number over phone
Requires immediate Pix deposit for hotelzinho

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Correios、Jadlog、Mercado Livre 全國客服皆為按鍵語音（URA）並索取 CPF，僅地方門市或維修站適合直撥。
usually_asked: Tracking code or Ordem de Serviço (OS) number

may_come_up.what: National carrier URA requires keypad CPF entry

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF or iFood/Mercado Livre delivery code (palavra-chave/código)

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 所有巴西電信、銀行、水電、醫保與航空客服一接通就是按鍵語音（URA）要求輸入 11 碼 CPF，AI 完全無法代辦。
usually_asked: URA prompt demanding 11-digit CPF via keypad ('digite seu CPF')
Birth date, mother's full name (nome da mãe!), and security token

may_come_up.what: Immediate keypad CPF gate + LGPD blocks third-party assistant

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF, birth date, card digits, password, or SMS token

transport.before_dialing_zh: 日常叫車多用 Uber 或 99 App；合作社無線計程車（Rádio Táxi / Cooperativa）、包車接機與地方租車行可電話叫車。
usually_asked: Street, number, bairro, reference point, and pickup time
Passengers and large suitcases (porta-malas grande if GNV cylinder!)

may_come_up.what: Many Rio/SP taxis have GNV gas tanks in trunk—request 'porta-malas livre/grande' for luggage!

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental (Localiza/Movida) asks CPF or CNH number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: QuintoAndar 全走 App 線上約看房；傳統房仲（Imobiliária / ZAP Imóveis）可電話約看房，會問租賃擔保方式。
usually_asked: Property code (código do imóvel) or street/bairro
Preferred visita date and hour (acessar portaria rules)

may_come_up.what: QuintoAndar listings must be scheduled inside the app
Condo portaria requires visitor document shown physically upon arrival

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF number over phone before visit
Requests Pix reservation fee before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 便民中心（Poupatempo）與機關需本人 CPF 線上預約；私立學校與幼兒園（Berçário）歡迎來電約參觀。
usually_asked: General public-service requirement or school visita pedagógica
Child age and shift (meio período vs integral) for berçário/escola

may_come_up.what: Public Poupatempo/Detran requires online Gov.br login appointment

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CPF or child birth date
